resources.string: This app provides no pinnable shortcuts.
All widgets, cards, the Dock, the Panel and the search get the colors of the new mode. Your backgrounds and pictures stay. You can still change each part on its own afterwards.
This color is used for the bubble when you scroll the app list and for the charging animation. You can give the charging animation its own color too.
Shape, size and icon pack for every app
Tap a point on the widget to use that exact color.
You have no action buttons yet. Make one under Settings → Elements → Action buttons.
While charging, bubbles rise across the home screen.
Lets you pin and open app shortcuts. Freiraum gets this by itself when it is your default launcher.
For the music widget and the dots on app icons.
Set Freiraum as the default launcher.
The folder and everything in it are deleted for good.
One background image or color for every screen
The app is also left out when you pick apps. Where it already is, on pages, in the Dock or in folders, it stays.
You then find the app only with the code below, not by its name.
Tap and swipe, with one or two fingers
Used by the Dock to open/close
Used by the Panel to open
The music widget only shows and controls what plays in these apps. If you check none, every app counts, browsers and video apps too.
The large album cover gets round corners.
After the last page comes the first one again, round in a circle.
Nothing on this page yet. Tap “Add row” for a widget or an element box.
All your apps in a list across the whole screen. You open it with a gesture, for example a swipe up.
This won\'t fit here anymore. Make a new page for it?
The widget reaches all the way to the screen edge. When off, it is as wide as the Dock.
It reaches all the way to the screen edge. When off, a small gap stays.
Leave it empty for the usual format, for example “Monday, 10/26/2026”. Or your own pattern like “EEEE, MM/dd/yyyy” or “MMM d”.
Your next alarm shows below the date.
Everything in one row instead of a grid, like the Dock

Everything gets bolder and easier to see. Elements are no longer see-through and get a clear border. Text is black or white. App icons, names and buttons get bigger. Blur and decorative animations are gone. Text grows with Android\'s font size.
No other folders. Create one above.

With a backup you move Freiraum to a new phone without setting everything up again. It holds your look with colors, designs, wallpapers and backgrounds. And your own things: pages, apps, folders, notes, addresses, contacts and links. Importing replaces everything and Freiraum restarts.
Everything is replaced by the backup: look, pages, apps, folders and your data. Freiraum restarts afterwards.
Backup found. Restarting to apply it…
Backup was created with a newer Freiraum version

The status bar disappears everywhere: on all pages, in the app list, the text search and folders. You can turn it back on for single screens afterwards. Swipe down from the top edge to see it briefly.
The status bar then disappears everywhere at once, no matter how each screen is set now.
When off, the Dock stays visible while a folder is open.
A round search button in the app list, in the same place as the button in the Dock.
A slim edge right above the keyboard. In your keyboard\'s color, it gives the keyboard round top corners.
Tap into the try-out line in the color menu. The keyboard opens and you see right away if the color fits.
A small arrow in the bezel. Tap it to close the keyboard.
Tap here to open the keyboard
Many keyboards use exactly these colors. Tap one and compare.
When off, tap the search field first and then the keyboard comes up.
No phone number for this contact.

Each category has two switches. Search on: its results come as you type. Rail on: it has a symbol in the rail beside the results. With only the rail on, its results come when you tap its symbol. Tap a symbol to change it and its color. Drag to sort. Web and Maps only pass your search on to your browser or maps app. Freiraum itself never goes online.
Usually Freiraum uses the browser and maps app you set in Android. Here you can pick others just for Freiraum. If the chosen app can\'t open something, the usual one steps in.
No widgets from other apps found
No weather yet. The weather comes from Breezy Weather or Gadgetbridge.
This widget no longer works. Maybe its app was removed or it came from a backup. Remove it and add it again.

No internet permission, no data collection. Everything stays on your phone.
All apps as a grid with its own search field. You open it with a gesture, an action button or from the Dock.
Tap the field and the full text search opens.
The keyboard bezel looks like the one in the text search.
Choose which of your folders appear in the grid.
Hide apps that are in these folders
The search button then only looks for apps, right in the list.
The launcher doesn\'t turn when you turn your phone
Symbol, opacity, fill, border and corners
Even at 0 you can still tap the buttons. You just can\'t see them.
Weather: the tall buttons change the hours, the wide ones the days. Notes: the buttons are left of the plus.
A calm, tidy home screen. Pages, widgets, search and looks all adapt to you, and nothing leaves your phone.
This is how you get everywhere. Tap a gesture and choose what it opens. You can change it any time under Settings → Pages → Gestures.

The button with the sliders in the Dock opens the settings. If you remove it, you find them through the text search or in Freiraum\'s app info. In the settings you can get designs, wallpapers and widgets under Extensions later.
Everything here is optional. Freiraum never goes online. Tap a row to allow it now, or do it later in the settings.
Your wallpaper has a picture for the lock screen too. Do you want it there? Only the lock screen changes.

Apps, folders and pages grow out of what you tap. Pages sink back a little while you swipe. And the back swipe shrinks the screen under your finger. If Android\'s Remove animations is on, there is none of this.
That\'s why there are no animations here. Tap to change it in Android (Color and motion).
Apps open out of their icon
App list, App grid and search zoom in
Ready-made looks with colors, borders, corners and effects

A design only changes how things look: colors, borders, corners and effects. Your pages, apps, folders, notes and backgrounds stay. Freiraum does not go online. So you download designs in the browser and add them here.
Shows you the designs in the browser
Brings back your look from before the design
To share it or as a start for your own design
That is not a valid Freiraum design
Also set the lock screen wallpaper
Looks great, but uses a little more battery
The design file is deleted from Freiraum. You can add it again any time.
You are using this design right now. Freiraum first brings back your own look, then deletes the design.
The higher, the rounder. Very round corners can cut off a bit at the edge.
A design is only the look: colors, borders, corners and effects. No pictures and nothing personal. So you can share it without worry.
A wallpaper brings a picture for every page, and one for the lock screen. It goes with every design.
Shows you the wallpapers in the browser
Every page gets a plain background: matte black in dark mode, chalk white in light mode. Your own pictures on the pages are replaced.
Every page gets a picture from the wallpaper. Pictures you set yourself are replaced.
This is not a Freiraum wallpaper
The wallpaper is deleted from Freiraum. The pictures stay on your pages until you choose others.
Takes everything recommended. You can change all of it later in the settings.
Colors, borders and effects. You see right away above how it looks. Neon and 3D are downloads.
A picture for every page, going with any design. More are downloads.
How round the corners are, for everything at once or each part on its own.
How this widget turns its pages. How the arrow buttons look counts for all widgets.
Launcher means the home screen, pages, widgets and folders. Settings means only the settings and the welcome tour. So one can be light and the other dark.
You can pick your own pictures any time later: Settings → Appearance → Background, or in the settings of each page.
Pick one shape for everything or for each part on its own. The small screens show you which part is which.
The categories sit in a rail beside the results, always above the keyboard. Tap one to jump to its results. Slide your finger along the rail to go through them all.

Favorites are the apps you want at hand right away. You pick them, Freiraum adds the apps you use most, or both. They are there as soon as you open the search. If Favorites is off in the categories below, tap the star in the rail. Press and hold an app in the search to add or remove it. What you open and how often stays on your phone.
Picked, topped up with the most opened
At the top, or right above the keyboard where your thumb reaches it easily.
Pick colors for everything, or tap a part in the table and give it its own colors. The small screens show you the result.
One field for everything: apps, contacts, places, links, settings and more. What is not on the phone goes on to your search engine, maps or AI app.
This is how the folder looks when open. Tap something to change or move it. You only see the dashed fields for adding here, not in the folder itself. The eye at the top right shows it without them.
This many apps stand in a row. What no longer fits moves to the next row, with the same number as the last one. Widgets are always as wide as the folder.
A folder gathers apps, places, links and widgets behind one tile. Tap a folder to set it up, or make a new one.
Pick apps below. You can add widgets and more right after.
The first engine starts when you tap the card or press Enter. Drag to sort.
Your question goes to the app, like when you share something. Freiraum itself never goes online.
Put %s where the search word goes, for example https://example.org/search?q=%s. Without %s the word is added at the end as ?q=.
To pick in the same card
Instead of the usual icon you can use your own picture or one from your icon pack. Pictures are cut to a square.
No AI app yet. Until there is one, you won\'t see the AI card.
In the results, not in the rail
On demand: results after a tap in the rail
The categories as a rail beside the results
Off: only the Search column counts
Icon pack: %1$s · shape and size for all apps
Its results show with every query.
A place in the rail. If only this is on, the results come after a tap there.
Tap a symbol to change it and its color. Drag ≡ to sort.
Tap the web card and the first engine opens. The others are right below it to choose from. Tap an icon to give it your own picture.
Tap the AI card and your question goes to the first app. The others are right below it to choose from. Tap an icon to give it your own picture.
This link could not be opened
Not an address a link can open
Upper or lower case doesn\'t matter. Without a code you still find the app by its name.
This is neither a Freiraum design nor a Freiraum wallpaper

Extensions bring something new into the launcher: a ready-made look, pictures for every page or data for a widget. You pick them in the browser. A tap there opens them here. Freiraum itself does not go online.
Shows you everything in the browser
You place widgets on a page as a row. Some show what is already on the phone. Others need data from the internet. They get it from an app of their own, so Freiraum stays offline.
With a data source of their own
The weather widget shows what a weather app sends. For example Breezy Weather, when its sharing with Gadgetbridge is on.
Apps that bring the weather, and how to set them up
This came from outside, through a link or a file, and is already added. Only use it if you trust where it came from. It only changes the look, and you can delete it any time.
Widgets sit as a row on a page, in the Panel or in a folder. You can add them later under Settings → Pages.
Notes and lists right on the page
Controls what is playing. Needs access to notifications
Needs a weather app that brings the weather. Freiraum itself does not go online
The weather widget is already included. For now the weather comes from Breezy Weather through Gadgetbridge. More weather apps will follow.
In the Dock an icon can get smaller, but not bigger than its place.
Use the arrows to put widgets between the rows. When the Panel is full, you can scroll. Just not while your finger is on a widget.
Widgets on top, below them apps, folders, links and more
Everything you can tap is an element. You set it up once and then place it anywhere.
You place elements in the Dock, the Panel, in Element-Boxes on your pages and in folders. Set them up under Settings > Apps and elements.
You set up elements here once and then place them anywhere: in the Dock, the Panel, Element-Boxes and folders.
Tap a row in the picture. Then you can edit or move it.
Open its own settings, or take it out of here.
For every page without its own background
Each line is a kind of result. Search means it comes as you type. Rail means it has a symbol in the rail beside the results. Drag the handle to sort. Tap a name for more settings.
The backup holds your whole launcher, notes, places, contacts and links too. It is locked with your password. Without it nobody can open the backup, not even us. Keep it safe.
Tap an element above to move it, set it up or remove it. A + adds something right there.
Paused. Turn the profile on to see its apps.
Locked. Unlock the space to see its apps.
When an app has a notification, its icon shows a small dot in your accent color. Freiraum only sees which app has one, never what it says. Ongoing things like music don\'t count.
Change the background for all pages
Here are the pages you most likely need next. First what goes with this page, then what is far away, then what you open often. All of it stays on your phone.
If the app is not in the text search, it is no favorite there either and isn\'t counted.
